research_unit: Observed whole interval update U and its fixed cohort prompt panel
teacher_forced_strict: retain separately, never rename as measured free-generation EM

estimands.U: theta_anchor - theta_start over all historically edited parameter blocks
estimands.intervention_scope: Current parameter removal with realized future updates fixed; not history replay

numeric_contract.materialization: cast once from endpoint64 minus U64 [minus V64]
numeric_contract.restore: copy immutable endpoint snapshot; exact tensor hash

censoring.target_equality: target entity id in this verified dataset
censoring.first_later_different_target: permanently censor old version from active retention starting at that batch
censoring.same_batch_conflict: exclude involved versions from active retention; do not order a joint batch by ordinal
censoring.raw_score_rows: retain all 10000 requests including censored versions

analysis.primary_subset: anchor active AND M_anchor>0 AND C_anchor>epsilon; apply active_t censoring at each t
analysis.report_denominators: both condition-on-retained/lost and all eligible active requests

cluster_bootstrap.meaning: query-composition sensitivity conditional on the observed fixed chain, not uncertainty over edit orders or model seeds

analysis.independent_write_count_warning: 10000 requests are not 10000 independent updates; primary temporal panel has 8 equal-sized historical U per arm

pair_stage.selection: max and min sum over past facts of count(future relation == fact relation AND future target_new_id == fact target_true_id)
pair_stage.exclude_last_block_reason: Removing (90,100] merely recovers the existing chronological W90 comparison
pair_stage.interpretation: conditional whole-block effect, not randomized causal effect of exposure counts

runtime.model_load_policy: once per family worker, reuse across endpoints
runtime.cache_key: materialized state tensor hash + prompt/target token identity + evaluator signature
